# Incompatibility Issue with PDO Returning Integer Values with PHP 8.1

When using PHP 8.1 with PrestaShop 8.0 (minimal version that support PHP 8.1), the function executeS() from the Db class returns integers for columns that are defined as tinyInt or unsignedInt in the database. In previous PHP versions (before 8.1), the values returned were always strings, regardless of the column type.

This change in behavior is due to PHP 8.1 no longer automatically casting values to strings. Unfortunately, many modules have historically relied on these values being returned as strings, which causes issues when comparing values like '1' === 1.

As a result, module integrations expecting stringified values are disrupted, leading to compatibility issues across PrestaShop versions that support PHP 8.1.

This breaking change is documented here : https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration81.incompatible.php#migration81.incompatible.pdo.sqlite

Exemple with Db->executeS() on ps_product table. 
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3a232848-bedd-488d-a0a7-f4268b9e220d)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c97d0c1f-286f-40a4-bd96-6d68057fb8b1)

## Attendu
The "PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES" parameter should be set to true on the PDO instance to maintain the historical behavior and avoid breaking changes.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab8f0b3b-04a1-4532-b58c-efcf70b33296)

## Étapes
- Run PrestaShop 8.X with PHP 7.4; 
- Dump result of Db-<executeS() query ;
- Run PrestaShop 8.X with PHP 8.1 ;
- Dump result of Db-<executeS() query ;
- Strict compare two result.
